description: This file defines the custom exception class AccountNumberFormatNotFoundException, which extends a base exception for resource not found errors. It is used to signal that a specific account number format identified by an ID does not exist.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatNotFoundException
classes.description: Custom runtime exception indicating that a specific account number format was not found, inheriting from AbstractPlatformResourceNotFoundException. It provides constructors to include the ID and optional cause.

methods.name: AccountNumberFormatNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message indicating the format with the given ID does not exist.

methods.name: AccountNumberFormatNotFoundException
methods.description: Constructor that creates an exception instance with a message and cause, using an EmptyResultDataAccessException.
